A 3D render attempt in *Project Diva* style.
I used two master models, and creating two sets in one.
One has a PVC figure-style finish .I really like how the skin turned out,
while the second leans more towards cel-shading (check the filenames: SetA or SetB).

PS: I generate batches of 1,500–2,000 images and then select the good ones; each image takes 1–2 minutes to create. For images I really like but that have major flaws (like having six toes...), I try to fix them, though the repair process can be time-consuming. While it would be possible to make every image perfect, I’m prioritizing a balance of good quantity and speed.
